about.text: Sarasson is a fresh preparation of central-eastern France, made from buttermilk and the older base of cervelle de canut. Buttermilk is poured into boiling water so the curds separate, then scooped into cloth, drained for about 24 hours, kneaded and shaped; under French rules it is not classed as a cheese.
